sections.heading: What is trending: “künstliche intelligenz”
paragraphs: “künstliche intelligenz” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for CH (snapshot taken 2026-08-13T05:04:35+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 100 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Blick, Spiegel, Tages-Anzeiger. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “350 Berufe im KI-Check: Wie stark lässt sich Ihr Job automatisieren?” — Tages-Anzeiger
“(S+) Künstliche Intelligenz und Informatik: Ist das das Ende der Programmierer?” — Spiegel
“KI-Boom könnte den Grossteil der Jobs kosten” — Blick

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Wed, 12 Aug 2026 14:40:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-08-13T05:04:35+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-08-13T05:05:05+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
